### Illustrative portfolio credit risk loss simulation

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
import json
import numpy as np
from statistics import NormalDist
from IPython.display import HTML, display

# Illustrative portfolio assumptions
N_LOANS = 1000                 # loans in the hypothetical portfolio
EAD_MIN, EAD_MAX = 1_000_000, 25_000_000   # each loan's size, drawn between £1m and £25m
PD_MIN, PD_MAX = 0.015, 0.045              # each loan's probability of default, drawn between 1.5% and 4.5%
RHO = 0.12                     # asset correlation via a shared economic factor
LGD = 0.45                     # loss given default
N_SIMS = 10_000
TAIL_LEVELS = [0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5]   # chance of a larger loss (%)

# The book is fixed: draw each loan's size and PD once
book_rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
ead = book_rng.uniform(EAD_MIN, EAD_MAX, N_LOANS)
pds = book_rng.uniform(PD_MIN, PD_MAX, N_LOANS)
cutoffs = np.array([NormalDist().inv_cdf(p) for p in pds], dtype=np.float32)
total_exposure = float(ead.sum())

# Simulate defaults through a shared economic factor (one-factor Gaussian copula)
rng = np.random.default_rng(2026)
systematic = rng.standard_normal((N_SIMS, 1), dtype=np.float32)
idiosyncratic = rng.standard_normal((N_SIMS, N_LOANS), dtype=np.float32)
asset_values = np.sqrt(RHO) * systematic + np.sqrt(1 - RHO) * idiosyncratic
defaulted = (asset_values < cutoffs).astype(np.float64)
loss_gbp = defaulted @ (ead * LGD)          # £ lost in each scenario
loss_pct = 100 * loss_gbp / total_exposure  # % of total exposure

levels = []
for tail in TAIL_LEVELS:
    var_gbp = float(np.percentile(loss_gbp, 100 - tail))
    levels.append({
        "tail": tail,
        "var_pct": round(100 * var_gbp / total_exposure, 2),
        "var_gbp": round(var_gbp),
        "scenarios_beyond": round(N_SIMS * tail / 100),
    })

BIN = 0.2  # percentage points per histogram bar
edges = np.arange(0, loss_pct.max() + BIN, BIN)
counts, edges = np.histogram(loss_pct, bins=edges)
data = {
    "edges": np.round(edges[:-1], 2).tolist(),
    "counts": counts.tolist(),
    "bin": BIN,
    "levels": levels,
    "expectedPct": round(float(loss_pct.mean()), 2),
    "expectedGbp": round(float(loss_gbp.mean())),
    "portfolioGbp": round(total_exposure),
    "nSims": N_SIMS,
}

WIDGET = r"""
<div class="var-widget">
  <div class="var-controls">
    <label class="var-slider-label" for="var-slider">Chance of a larger loss: <strong id="var-level-label">1%</strong></label>
    <input type="range" id="var-slider" class="var-slider" min="0" max="7" step="1" value="4" aria-label="Chance of a larger loss, from 0.1% to 2.5%">
    <div class="var-scale" aria-hidden="true"><span>0.1%</span><span>2.5%</span></div>
  </div>
  <p class="var-readout" id="var-readout" aria-live="polite"></p>
  <div class="var-chart" id="var-chart"></div>
  <p class="var-small" id="var-expected"></p>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  var D = __DATA__;
  var slider = document.getElementById("var-slider");
  var svgBox = document.getElementById("var-chart");
  var readout = document.getElementById("var-readout");
  var expectedBox = document.getElementById("var-expected");
  var levelLabel = document.getElementById("var-level-label");
  if (!slider || !svgBox || !readout || !expectedBox || !levelLabel) { return; }

  var BLUE = "#2780E3", ORANGE = "#E36A27", GREY = "#6c757d", GRID = "#e6e6e6";
  var W = 800, H = 360;
  var M = { top: 24, right: 24, bottom: 56, left: 64 };
  var innerW = W - M.left - M.right;
  var innerH = H - M.top - M.bottom;
  var BIN = D.bin;
  var maxX = D.edges[D.edges.length - 1] + BIN;
  var maxCount = 0;
  for (var k = 0; k < D.counts.length; k++) {
    if (D.counts[k] > maxCount) { maxCount = D.counts[k]; }
  }
  var yMax = Math.ceil((maxCount * 1.1) / 100) * 100;

  function xPos(v) { return M.left + (v / maxX) * innerW; }
  function yPos(c) { return M.top + innerH - (c / yMax) * innerH; }
  function fmt(n) { return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-GB"); }
  function gbp(x) {
    if (x >= 1000000000) { return "£" + (x / 1000000000).toFixed(2) + "bn"; }
    if (x >= 1000000) { return "£" + (x / 1000000).toFixed(2) + "m"; }
    return "£" + Math.round(x / 1000) + "k";
  }
  function text(x, y, label, opts) {
    opts = opts || {};
    return '<text x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" font-size="' + (opts.size || 12) +
      '" fill="' + (opts.fill || GREY) + '" text-anchor="' + (opts.anchor || "middle") + '"' +
      (opts.weight ? ' font-weight="' + opts.weight + '"' : "") + ">" + label + "</text>";
  }

  function buildChart(L) {
    var out = [];
    var base = yPos(0);

    for (var t = 0; t <= 4; t++) {
      var value = (yMax * t) / 4;
      var gy = yPos(value);
      out.push('<line x1="' + M.left + '" x2="' + (W - M.right) + '" y1="' + gy + '" y2="' + gy + '" stroke="' + GRID + '"/>');
      out.push(text(M.left - 8, gy + 4, fmt(value), { anchor: "end" }));
    }

    var barW = innerW / D.counts.length;
    for (var i = 0; i < D.counts.length; i++) {
      var x = xPos(D.edges[i]);
      var top = yPos(D.counts[i]);
      var fill = D.edges[i] >= L.var_pct ? ORANGE : BLUE;
      out.push('<rect x="' + (x + 0.5).toFixed(2) + '" y="' + top.toFixed(2) +
        '" width="' + Math.max(barW - 1, 0.5).toFixed(2) + '" height="' + Math.max(base - top, 0).toFixed(2) +
        '" fill="' + fill + '"/>');
    }

    out.push('<line x1="' + M.left + '" x2="' + (W - M.right) + '" y1="' + base + '" y2="' + base + '" stroke="' + GREY + '"/>');
    for (var p = 0; p <= Math.floor(maxX); p++) {
      var tx = xPos(p);
      out.push('<line x1="' + tx + '" x2="' + tx + '" y1="' + base + '" y2="' + (base + 5) + '" stroke="' + GREY + '"/>');
      out.push(text(tx, base + 20, p + "%"));
    }

    var xv = xPos(L.var_pct);
    out.push('<line x1="' + xv + '" x2="' + xv + '" y1="' + M.top + '" y2="' + base + '" stroke="' + ORANGE + '" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>');
    out.push(text(xv + 6, M.top + 14, "Loss exceeded with " + L.tail + "% chance: " + L.var_pct.toFixed(2) + "%",
      { anchor: "start", fill: ORANGE, weight: 600 }));

    out.push(text(M.left + innerW / 2, H - 12, "Portfolio loss (% of total exposure)", { size: 13 }));
    out.push('<text transform="translate(16 ' + (M.top + innerH / 2) + ') rotate(-90)" font-size="13" fill="' + GREY + '" text-anchor="middle">Number of simulations</text>');

    return '<svg viewBox="0 0 ' + W + " " + H + '" role="img" aria-label="Histogram of simulated portfolio losses. Outcomes at or beyond the ' +
      L.tail + '% chance threshold are highlighted in orange.">' + out.join("") + "</svg>";
  }

  function render(idx) {
    var L = D.levels[idx];
    svgBox.innerHTML = buildChart(L);
    levelLabel.textContent = L.tail + "%";
    slider.setAttribute("aria-valuetext", L.tail + "% chance of a larger loss");
    readout.innerHTML =
      "With a " + L.tail + "% chance, the portfolio loses more than <strong>" + L.var_pct.toFixed(2) +
      "%</strong> of its exposure, about <strong>" + gbp(L.var_gbp) + "</strong>. " +
      "This happens in about " + fmt(L.scenarios_beyond) + " of " + fmt(D.nSims) + " simulated scenarios.";
    expectedBox.textContent =
      "Average (expected) loss across all scenarios: " + D.expectedPct.toFixed(2) + "% of exposure, about " +
      gbp(D.expectedGbp) + ". Total exposure: " + gbp(D.portfolioGbp) + ".";
  }

  slider.addEventListener("input", function () { render(Number(slider.value)); });
  render(Number(slider.value));
})();
</script>
"""

display(HTML(WIDGET.replace("__DATA__", json.dumps(data))))
```

<p class="var-small">Move the slider to choose a chance of a larger loss and see how much a portfolio of 1,000 loans could lose with that chance. Each of the 10,000 simulated scenarios draws a set of defaults, which are linked through a shared economic factor. This is the kind of analysis I run for lenders and banks. The figures are illustrative only.</p>
<p class="var-small">Illustrative: 1,000 loans, each between £1m and £25m, with a probability of default between 1.5% and 4.5%, 45% loss given default and 10,000 simulated scenarios. Not a risk model for any real portfolio.</p>
